content.json:
## Model risk register
Scenario results, CI gate outcomes, drift and HITL sign-offs emitted by `modelrisk` (custom events `modelrisk.*`). Synthetic data only.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'modelrisk.gate'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), ok = tobool(customDimensions.ok)
| summarize runs = count(), failures = countif(ok == false) by model
| order by failures desc
content.title: Gate outcomes by model

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'modelrisk.scenario'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), scenario = tostring(customDimensions.scenario), status = tostring(customDimensions.status), value = todouble(customDimensions.value)
| where status != 'pass'
| project timestamp, model, scenario, status, value
content.title: Scenario breaches

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'modelrisk.drift'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), psi = todouble(customDimensions.psi_score)
| summarize max_psi = max(psi) by model, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Drift (PSI) by model

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'modelrisk.residual'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), risk = tostring(customDimensions.risk), residual = todouble(customDimensions.residual), within = tobool(customDimensions.within_appetite)
| where within == false
| project timestamp, model, risk, residual
content.title: Residual risk above appetite

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'modelrisk.signoff'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions.model), stage = tostring(customDimensions.stage), role = tostring(customDimensions.role), decision = tostring(customDimensions.decision)
| project timestamp, model, stage, role, decision
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: HITL sign-offs
